meta.question: how far from uniform can the underlying mare unit be before the Runcorn (1975) negligible-external-field argument stops holding and the K=1 outcrop inversion degrades
meta.noise_model: i.i.d. zero-mean Gaussian sigma_B = 0.50 nT per axis per station; ONE matched noise matrix (N_mc x nD) reused for every sweep point so differences isolate the background

background_slab.padding_magnetization: each realization's own core-mean magnetization, so the model decomposes exactly into (uniform slab at the realization mean) + (zero-mean core fluctuation)
background_slab.direction_distribution: polar angle theta = |N(0, sigma_theta)| clipped to [0,180] deg from -z_hat, azimuth U(0,2pi); 'uniform_sphere' level is exactly isotropic

sweeps.sweep_1_as_specified: log-uniform intensity over [0.01,1]*M_NRM_min AND direction dispersion sigma_theta
sweeps.sweep_2_direction_only: intensity held at exactly M_NRM_min, sigma_theta swept; isolates angular dispersion. The sigma_theta = 0 point of this sweep IS the perfectly uniform slab, so this sweep is the one with a genuine bracketed 5 deg crossing
sweeps.sweep_3_intensity_only: all directions exactly -z_hat, log-uniform intensity floor swept over [1.0, 0.8, 0.5, 0.2, 0.05, 0.01]; isolates intensity scatter
sweeps.why_decomposed: in sweep 1 the specified 100x log-uniform intensity range alone dominates the incoherent background field, so the sigma_theta axis is nearly flat (5.9 -> 6.3 deg from sigma_theta = 0 to 90 deg) and the 5 deg threshold is already exceeded at sigma_theta = 0; sweeps 2 and 3 separate the two contributions

variants.raw: background field as drawn, INCLUDING the uniform-slab edge artifact
variants.dc_removed: uniform-case field subtracted: d_raw - U_all @ m_core_mean, i.e. the pure zero-mean fluctuation field

inversion.free_parameters: 3 (outcrop Mx,My,Mz); geometry fixed and exactly known
inversion.primary: cold-start zero-reference weighted least squares, K = inversion_helpers.ls_operator(G_outcrop); the isolated_outcrop_1cm.py path
inversion.secondary: inversion_helpers.iterative_recover_M: ProjectedGNCG({'maxIter': 20, 'maxIterCG': 20, 'tolCG': 0.0001}) + Smallness(zero reference) + BetaEstimate_ByEig(beta0_ratio=0.0001) + UpdatePreconditioner + TargetMisfit(chifact=1.0); headline coherence arm only
inversion.phi_d_convention: simpeg L2DataMisfit returns sum((r/sigma)^2) = chi^2 (no 0.5 prefactor); target = nD, NOT 0.5*nD; normalized residual rms = sqrt(phi_d/nD)

meta.geometry_note: paper geometry: sensor at z = 0 in the body frame of the prism centred on the origin, i.e. mid-height of a 4x4x1 m prism standing on the ground (sensor 0.5 m above ground); drive-by x = -8..+8 m. 'sensor_height_m' in meta is the body-frame value. Run by analysis/a05_background_and_correlated_noise.py

crossing_status_legend.below_lowest_sampled: threshold already exceeded at the smallest value sampled; true crossing is below the sampled range
crossing_status_legend.not_reached: threshold never reached over the sampled range
